description: Release-reviewed availability for portal navigation. Non-operational screens require an explicit limitation so fixture, read-only, or unavailable modules cannot be silently certified as live.

/deals.limitation: Discovery page; commercial eligibility is revalidated during checkout.

/search.evidence: Database-backed catalog search with server-controlled result visibility.

/support.evidence: Authenticated ticket creation and ticket register.

/wishlist.limitation: Browser-local wishlist; not synchronized across devices.

/cart.limitation: Browser-local cart; server revalidates commercial facts at checkout.

/login.evidence: Credentials authentication with current-state authorization checks.

/b2b/rfq/new.limitation: RFQ submission works; file attachments are unavailable.

/b2b/billing.limitation: Ledger view works; statement and PDF download actions are unavailable.

/b2b/analytics.limitation: Database-derived spend reporting; no export or scheduled delivery.

/b2b/team.limitation: Membership governance works; secure invitation acceptance is not activated.

/b2b/company.limitation: Verified company profile display; self-service profile editing is unavailable.

/analytics.limitation: Seller-scoped database reporting; no export scheduling.

/products.limitation: Catalog register and updates work; product creation is unavailable.

/issues.limitation: Existing-SKU CSV updates only; bulk product creation is unavailable.

/orders.evidence: Seller-scoped order register and fulfilment transitions.

/shipments.limitation: Manual shipment state transitions; no carrier integration.

/messages.limitation: RFQ inbox only; general buyer messaging is unavailable.

/payouts.limitation: Payout ledger only; no external payout rail is activated.

/invoices.limitation: Invoice ledger only; PDF download is unavailable.

/commission.limitation: Commission ledger and status display only.

/documents.limitation: Document register is visible; upload, view, and renewal actions are not connected.

/compliance.limitation: Compliance status view only; onboarding document delivery is unavailable.

/support/tickets.limitation: Existing seller tickets are visible; new-ticket submission is unavailable.

/support/contact.limitation: Screen explicitly reports that seller-to-admin messaging is not connected.

/settings.limitation: Seller profile and security state are visible; self-service changes and two-factor enrollment are unavailable.

/ai-insights.limitation: Screen explicitly reports that no certified AI pipeline is configured.

/automation.limitation: Static example automation rules; no execution engine.

/deals.limitation: Static example deals; use the governed Campaigns module for live promotions.

/pricing.limitation: Database-backed pricing and commission audit view.

/quotes.limitation: Static example quotes; not an operational marketplace register.

/approvals.limitation: Cross-company approval oversight; buyer companies make decisions.

/orders.limitation: Marketplace-wide order oversight; sellers own fulfilment transitions.

/shipments.limitation: Static example shipment oversight; seller shipment registers hold live records.

/returns.limitation: Static example return records; not the governed return register.

/warehouse/pickpack.evidence: Database-backed pick, pack, and dispatch workflow.

/crm.limitation: Database-backed account activity view; no external CRM synchronization.

/payments.limitation: Payment ledger only; bank-transfer verification is unavailable.

/vat.limitation: Tax ledger only; downloadable statutory document delivery is unavailable.

/disputes.limitation: Database-backed dispute register; external case management is unavailable.

/sla.limitation: Database-derived SLA view; no external paging integration.

/users.evidence: Governed user status and data-rights administration.

/integrations.limitation: Configuration and health visibility; external systems require activation.

/audit.limitation: Database audit register; external tamper-evident retention is not activated.

/settings.limitation: Environment capability and tax configuration visibility.
